About this Condo

This property is a 360 SqM condo with 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms that is available for sale. It is part of the Edge Central Pattaya project in Nong Prue, Chon Buri and was completed in Jan 2021. You can buy this condo for a base price of ฿11,700,000 (฿32,500/SqM).
